entities.name: Staff of Zegon
entities.description: A dark wooden staff topped with a dolphin's skull, built by Ashnod to weaken targets by affecting nerves.

entities.name: Ashnod
entities.description: Builder of the Staff of Zegon, later Mishra's apprentice.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Leader whose maq fawa was kept from Zegon; took Ashnod as apprentice.

entities.name: Maq fawa
entities.description: Mishra's force kept from approaching Zegon.

events.summary: Ashnod snuck into Mishra's camp and used the staff on Hajar.
events.quote: Ashnod snuck into Mishra's camp with the staff and used it on Hajar

events.summary: Impressed, Mishra took Ashnod on as his apprentice.
events.quote: Mishra was so impressed with Ashnod's design of the staff that he took her on as his apprentice

relations.quote: he took her on as his apprentice
